changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions into one clear statement and normalized criteria abbreviations to full names

overall_notes: The paper focuses on opinion summarization using a weakly-supervised approach with mix-structured data. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization of metric variants and model names. The paper uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, Aspect Coverage) and human evaluation with Best-Worst Scaling. No LLMs are used as judges.
